request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 in Tunis lost all service for a few hours yesterday evening. What happened? Now: 2026-09-03 09:00 (Thursday, Africa/Tunis). Data after this time does

response.text: The external events check (T7) confirmed there were no public holidays, stadium events, or other external factors during the incident window. The root cause is fully established as a transport fiber loss of signal (ALM-000001 LINK_LOS on LNK-TUN-01-A) starting at 18:00 and clearing at 22:00 on 2026-09-02, which caused both sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 to lose all service. No changes, maintenance, or external events contributed to the outage.
